 BGMI: Krafton India Reveals Upcoming 4.7 Update Details, Including Popularity Battle Annual Gala, and More
 A lot of new content.
 By   Aritra Bhowmick   
 Updated: Nov. 12, 2026, 6:36 p.m. 
 Related reads: BGMI Air Opens Pre-Registrations for iOS Ahead of December Launch 
 Krafton India has revealed more details about the upcoming 4.7 update for Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) , including the Popularity Battle Annual Gala and several other additions. More like this BGMI 4.7 Update Features Arctic Chronicles, Erangel Subzero Mode, and Snow Festival 
The BGMI 4.7 update, arriving on November 18, will introduce the Popularity Battle Annual Gala, featuring nine ranking tiers, with the top tier limited to just 3,000 players. The top-ranked players will earn exclusive in-game honours, while all registered participants will get a chance to win the Starlight Grand Prize. Registrations for the Annual Gala will open on November 18, with the main event scheduled to run from November 25 to December 27. The update will also bring a Team Popularity Battle in December as well.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by BGMI: BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE INDIA (@battlegroundsmobilein_official) 
 Alongside the Annual Gala, the update will bring Chicko's Loot, a seasonal reward experience running from November 20, 2026, to January 21, 2027. Players can earn Lucky Eggs through different game modes or receive them as gifts from friends. These eggs can then be redeemed for rewards at the Event Shop. The event will also feature a Lucky Egg-themed mini-game in December.
 Beyond the new events, the mode selection screen will also receive a complete redesign, with two dedicated sections, Mine and Discover.
 These additions will join the new gameplay content announced earlier. As revealed previously, the 4.7 update will also include the Arctic Chronicles-themed mode and the Erangel Subzero mode . It will also bring new vehicles, cold-weather gear, and several other additions.
 In other news, Krafton has opened pre-registrations for its upcoming game, BGMI Air, for iOS users .
